# Photo Organizer Constitution

## Core Principles

### I. Library-First
Every feature starts as a standalone library with its own tests.
Libraries must be self-contained and documented.

### II. Test-First (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
Tests are written and fail before the implementation.
Red, green, refactor is enforced.

### III. Simplicity
Start simple and add complexity only when a requirement needs it.

## Governance

This constitution supersedes other practices.
Amendments need documentation, approval and a migration plan.
